proposed_comments.title: Treat standalone carriage returns as stderr line terminators

confidence.rationale: The current branch returns on a bare carriage return without emitting or resetting the buffered line, and the existing reader treats line terminators as log record boundaries.

proposed_comments.title: Bound package.json before reading and deserializing it

confidence.rationale: TryParseFile currently reads the entire extension-controlled package.json into a string and then deserializes it, with no file-size gate before allocation.

proposed_comments.title: Use ordinal containment checks for case-sensitive directories

confidence.rationale: The current StartsWith comparison is explicitly case-insensitive even though Windows directories can be case-sensitive, allowing a differently-cased sibling prefix to match.

proposed_comments.title: Fail closed while walking the resolved manifest path

confidence.rationale: The path walk uses case-insensitive comparisons and treats missing path segments as safe, so validation can pass without checking the actual segment.

proposed_comments.title: Avoid partial notification frames on caller cancellation

confidence.rationale: The caller token is passed to the actual transport write, so cancellation can interrupt a frame after bytes have reached the stream while leaving the connection reusable.

proposed_comments.title: Serialize RPC method registration side effects

confidence.rationale: ConcurrentDictionary.GetOrAdd may invoke the factory more than once, and the factory registers the target method as a side effect.

proposed_comments.title: Do not synchronously wait for JSON-RPC pumps during Dispose

confidence.rationale: Dispose waits for the notification/error/RPC tasks even when it is called from one of those same callbacks, so reentrant shutdown blocks on its caller.

proposed_comments.title: Bound inbound JSON-RPC frames and queued notification memory

confidence.rationale: The current transport accepts arbitrary Content-Length/header sequences and bounds notification backlog by count even though each JsonElement can retain a large frame.

proposed_comments.body:
### Bound inbound JSON-RPC frames and queued notification memory

**Severity:** `high`

The transport currently relies on the default header-delimited reader and can accept oversized headers or Content-Length values before allocating the body buffer. The notification queue is also capped only by item count, so a slow handler can retain many large cloned payloads; add explicit inbound frame/header limits plus aggregate queued-payload accounting so extension-controlled traffic stays bounded.

proposed_comments.title: Apply bounded admission control to inbound requests

confidence.rationale: The JSON-RPC instance runs without a synchronization context, so inbound request handlers can run concurrently and the defined ServerBusy code is otherwise unused.

proposed_comments.body:
### Apply bounded admission control to inbound requests

**Severity:** `high`

With SynchronizationContext set to null, inbound requests can dispatch concurrently. Gate request handlers with a finite capacity and return the existing ServerBusy error when the limit is exhausted so a burst of extension requests cannot consume unbounded host work while still leaving room for reentrant callbacks.

proposed_comments.title: Treat clean EOF between frames as normal disconnect

confidence.rationale: The current reader throws EndOfStreamException before the next header, which StreamJsonRpc classifies as a stream fault instead of a normal remote termination.

proposed_comments.body:
### Treat clean EOF between frames as normal disconnect

**Severity:** `medium`

When EOF arrives before a new header starts, the message handler should return null so StreamJsonRpc reports a normal remote termination. Throwing EndOfStreamException in that state makes ordinary extension exits look like protocol errors and raises the public error event unnecessarily.
